_ghi_nguon: Hai bản trên trang Pisces (astrology) + Pisces (constellation): mở bằng bản Aphrodite và Eros hoá cá trốn Typhon (không có câu đặt lên trời ngắn gọn), rồi chuyển sang bản quả trứng trên sông Euphrates — cá đẩy trứng vào bờ, Aphrodite nở ra và đặt hai con cá lên trời (câu kết rõ nhất). Câu Wikipedia tự nói "Another myth…" nên chuyển bản không gượng. Typhon + Pan dùng lại từ Capricorn. Bỏ câu Hyginus về Euphrates trên trang constellation vì kèm ngoặc trích nguồn (Poeticon astronomicon 2.30…).

moc.chu: Typhon, the "father of all monsters", had been sent by Gaia to attack the gods, which led Pan to warn the others before himself changing into a goat-fish and jumping into the Euphrates.
Pisces is associated with the Greek legend that Aphrodite and her son Eros either shape-shifted into forms of fishes to escape, or were rescued by two fishes.
A similar myth, one in which the fish "Pisces" carries Aphrodite and her son out of danger, is resounded in Manilius' five-volume poetic work Astronomica: "Venus ow'd her safety to their Shape."
Another myth is that an egg fell into the Euphrates River.
It was then rolled to the shore by fish.
Doves sat on the egg until it hatched, out from which came Aphrodite.
As a sign of gratitude towards the fish, Aphrodite put the fish into the night sky.

site: Pisces wants to feel connected to something larger.
